# Peace Be Still

> Peace Be Still is a coming-soon phone app (App Store and Google Play; no launch date yet) for the end of the day, made by Spry Labs. Tagline: "A great calm, every night." It opens with one question, "What do you need tonight?", and two doors: God's Word and Mindset.

- God's Word door: the whole King James Bible to read and hear, Bible chat (AI, labelled as AI; verses quoted word for word from stored KJV text), a daily Bible story, whispered Psalms for sleep. Journeys: Hush Harbor · Black Bible Chat & Stories; Mi Refugio · Biblia y Chat en Español (Reina-Valera 1909); Psalm Nights · Whispered Scripture for Sleep; Morning Word · Daily Declarations; Young Faith · Bible for Teens.
- Mindset door: Imagination Nights (whispered night sessions built from a scene you write) and daily declarations.
- Price: free lane forever (whole KJV to read, a growing set of chapters read aloud, today's story, 1 chat a day of up to 10 messages, first sleep night then one a week, daily declaration). Paid lane $7.99 a month or $39.99 a year. No trial, no weekly plan, no ads, cancel in two taps.
- Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play: search "Peace Be Still". No launch date. No waitlist.
